name: Dan — same flying as Niamh, different plans
summary: Answer-for-answer identical to persona 04 except for one thing: he wants to start flying cross-country and get into the mountains this year. Same coastal background, same hours, same skills, same honest 'thermalling hasn't really come up'.
why_this_persona: The paired control for the stated-plans exemption. Not an independent pilot profile — he exists only so a reviewer can see that the exemption is driven by stated plans and nothing else, and that it moves the result in the conservative direction only. Identical scores to persona 04, different recommendation. Exercises 'unevidenced_core_checks:thermal_turn_control'.

notes: Computed skills 83.9, psychological 97.9, total 90.6 — identical to persona 04, because the 'ambitions' question is zero-weighted and no answer in it adds or removes a point.

Core invariant from knowledge/disagreements.md point 9: no ambitions answer may ever make a result MORE generous. Comparing 04 and 05 proves the direction — the only pilot whose result changes because of the ambitions answer is the one with narrower plans, and he changes toward Ready, not away from it. A scorer that produced Ready here, or Nearly ready for persona 04, would be inverting the asymmetry.

'ambition_without_readiness' must NOT fire. It requires an ambition in [longer_xc, competitions, acro] and a skills score below 55; he ticks neither condition — 'xc_flights' and 'hike_fly' are not on the gate's list and his skills score is 83.9.

'scope_matches_your_plans' must NOT fire for him. It is the suggestion that explains the exemption, and he isn't exempted. He gets 'thermalling_untested' instead, which names the gap without the scope framing.
